name: Google Drives
author: Spencer Owen
description: Native Google Drive mounts for multiple accounts, with disk usage bounded by a local cache: bar status, storage usage, and pause/resume.

barWidget.description: Sign in to one or more Google Drive accounts, see mount status and storage per account, and pause or resume mounting.

schema.label: Mount root
schema.description: Parent directory holding one mount folder per account, e.g. ~/GoogleDrive/Personal.

schema.label: Show storage usage in the panel
